study type: Process evaluation embedded within a randomized controlled trial
exposure: Four non-clinical interventions to promote informed decision-making surrounding mode of birth
outcome: Informed decision-making surrounding mode of birth
cohort: Low-risk women in 32 healthcare facilities across Argentina, Burkina Faso, Thailand, and Viet Nam
finding: The QUALI-DEC process evaluation will assess the implementation and mechanisms of change of four non-clinical interventions aimed at reducing caesarean sections among low-risk women.
mod_finding: The study aims to understand how the interventions influence decision-making surrounding mode of birth.
